meta.name: add-gcal-tool
meta.description: Add Google Calendar as an MCP tool (list calendars, list/search/create events, free/busy queries) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. Multi-calendar and multi-account supported. Mirrors /add-gmail-tool's stub pattern — no raw credentials ever reach the container; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把谷歌日历变成可调用的工具，自动管理日程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在工作流中直接操作谷歌日历
copy.tagline_en: Turn Google Calendar into a callable tool to manage schedules automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate Google Calendar directly in your workflow

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能直接操作你的 Google 日历:列出日历、查看或搜索日程、新建事件、查空闲时段,并支持多个日历和账号。
howto.when: 当你提出查看日历、查询日程、创建事件等与 Google 日历相关的请求时,Claude 就会使用这个工具来处理。

say.note: Claude 会调用日历工具返回你的日历列表。
它会搜索那天的日程并告诉你。

say.text: 帮我建一个明天下午3点的会议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can directly operate your Google Calendar: list calendars, view/search events, create events, and check free/busy times, with multi-calendar and multi-account support.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude anything involving Google Calendar, such as viewing a calendar, checking schedules, or creating events, it will use this tool.

say_en.text: What's on my calendar next Monday?
